in_hebrew.name: אֲלֶכְסִינֶה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: The Hebrew name Alexine is derived from the Hebrew word אֲלֶך, which means 'helper'. The suffix סִינֶה comes from the Hebrew word סין, which means 'man'. Thus, Alexine means 'helper of mankind'.

in_greek.name: Αλεξίνη
in_greek.long_meaning: The Greek name Alexine is derived from the Greek word αλέξις, which means 'defender' or 'helper'. The suffix νη is a feminine ending, making Alexine a feminine name. Thus, Alexine means 'defender of men'.

in_latin.name: Alexina
in_latin.long_meaning: The Latin name Alexina is derived from the Latin word 'alexis', which means 'helper'. Thus, Alexina means 'helper'.
